urlParams: ?$apply=filter(financialDataSet eq 'OPEX_ReferenceRate' AND financialCategory/name in ('Workforce','LFA Fees','Professional fees','Travel','Office Infrastructure','CCM Funding')<filterString>)/groupby((periodFrom,financialCategory/name),aggregate(actualAmount with sum as actual, plannedAmount with sum as planned))
annualTotalsUrlParams: ?$apply=filter(financialDataSet eq 'OPEX_ReferenceRate' AND financialCategory/name ne 'Total operating costs'<filterString>)/groupby((periodFrom),aggregate(actualAmount with sum as actual))
